title: Dedicated capacity 1:1 prep - SP
content:
Meeting prep notes (1:1 with Jordan) - Dedicated capacity
Date: 2026-03-04 sync (1:1)
Purpose: quick alignment on Q2 pool commitments, autoscaling policy changes, and ask for go/no-go on reservation increases for east-us region.

Topline summary:
- Current committed GPUs: 420 A100-40GB equiv across Dedicated pools (east-us 180, west-us 120, eu-west 120).
- Average utilization (last 30d): 68% overall, east-us 81% during peak 10:00-16:00 PT.
- Forecasted incremental demand: +90 GPU equivalents over next 6 weeks due to 2 enterprise onboarding (Customer X & Y) + internal ML evals (Model Z).
- Cost impact if reserved now vs. on-demand: estimated incremental monthly commitment $52k, ~18% saving vs. burst-on-demand at projected usage.

Key questions to take to Jordan:
1) Approve increasing east-us reserved pool by +60 GPUs (target: 240) for April 1 onboarding.
2) Approve a temporary burst budget of $15k for 2 weeks post-onboard to avoid throttling while autoscale warm-up happens.
3) Revisit autoscaling cooldown: current cooldown 5m leads to oscillation during short spikes — propose bump to 10m for east-us pool and add scheduled scale windows for daily peak.
4) Decision on enabling predictive pre-scale (ML-based) for high-value customers (requires infra work tracked in INF-2561).

Data points / evidence to highlight:
- Utilization heatmap (last 30d): east-us shows repeated saturation 12 days in last 30 (avg 88% during peaks).
- Queue latency: median queue wait for standard jobs in east-us = 420ms (target <200ms).
- Customer X contract: commit SLA requires <250ms p95 latency; onboarding scheduled 2026-04-05.
- Cost calc snapshot: spreadsheet linked in Confluence page above (see tab 'East-US commit calc').

Risks / concerns:
- If we under-commit and rely on on-demand, risk of degraded p95 latency for paying customers and potential SLA credit exposure.
- Upside: commit now may lock us into capacity that could stay unused if sales slip — mitigation: phased commit + canary reserve release policy (discussion needed with finance).
- Operational: enabling predictive pre-scale adds complexity and a short-term regression risk to cold start behavior. Need rollout plan + eval set.

Proposed immediate plan (ask):
- Short-term (decision needed this week): +60 GPUs reserved east-us effective 2026-04-01. Approve $15k burst buffer.
- Medium-term (next 4 weeks): implement cooldown change to 10m for east-us pool; schedule daily pre-scale at 09:30 PT to ramp before 10:00 peak.
- Evaluation: run 2-week A/B with Customer X on predictive pre-scale vs. standard autoscale (INF-2561).

Action items I want to own / propose during 1:1: 
- Samir: finalize reservation request and submit to finance (INF-2487) by 2026-03-05.
- Jordan: sign-off on reserve + burst budget (one-line approval) by 2026-03-06.
- Ava: prepare short runbook for cooldown change and rollback steps (due 2026-03-10).
- Priya: coordinate customer onboarding timeline and risk checklist with CS (due 2026-03-08).

Notes to self (things to remember to say):
- Emphasize SLA risk and concrete latency numbers rather than abstract utilization.
- Mention that cost delta is modest and gets amortized quickly vs. SLA failures.
- Ask for a contingency channel with finance to speed up reserve approvals for future urgent onboardings.

Open questions I need answers to before pushing reserve:
- Is there an existing headroom policy from finance for one-off reserve bumps? (If yes, get link/owner.)
- Can we convert reserved GPUs to shorter-term commitments if a deal slips? (Terms/legal)
- What is expected lead time for procurement of additional hardware in private deployments if we go that route?

Follow-ups after 1:1 (draft):
- If approved: create purchase request ticket (INF-2487) + update Confluence capacity table + post note to #dedicated-capacity channel with dates and rollback plan.
- If deferred: prepare a 'soft-throttle' plan with customer success to limit non-critical jobs during peak until we can commit.

Quick checklist for meeting:
- Bring heatmap screenshot + p95 latency chart (east-us)
- Bring cost calc (spreadsheet link)
- Highlight Customer X SLA language
- Have a recommended rollback timeline (48h) ready

Mini-raw log / scratch ideas (brain dump):
- Could we offer Customer X an onboarding discount in exchange for flexible start date? (reduces immediate capacity need)
- Explore temporary use of partner infra (cloud-marketplace) as stopgap — check procurement lead times and bandwidth.
- Consider adding a simple 'priority queue' flag for SLA customers to reduce required headroom.

TODO (short):
- [ ] Finalize reserve numbers & submit to finance (Samir) - due 2026-03-05
- [ ] Draft upgrade message for #dedicated-capacity channel if approved (Samir) - due 2026-03-06
- [ ] Ava: prepare runbook for cooldown change - due 2026-03-10
- [ ] Priya: confirm Customer X onboarding milestones and slack channel - due 2026-03-08

End of notes.
